annotations.text:
Four takes on the same screen. Same twelve watches, same data, same five states.

The thing to judge: scan each one and find the FAILING cards. If your eye lands on them before the sold-out ones, the design works. A dead monitor and a quiet market look identical unless the design separates them.

States, in every flavor: IN STOCK (the win) · SOLD OUT (recedes) · ARMED (polling fast) · FAILING (broken, state is stale) · NO BASELINE (first check pending).

Each is an icon AND a word, so it survives being read without color. Target and Best Buy are FAILING here; Target is also ARMED, to prove the two can stack.
